title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Table
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：dynasty　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dynasty 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1936 my teacher ① wrote of a dynasty that no student in the school would have dated, and he said the writing was the whole of the winter. The ② dynasty, meaning the age and not the house, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a dynasty, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left undated.

Every ③ dynasty in that school had the same short table at the end of it, and the ④ dynasty at the end, meaning the one they kept for the later age and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A dynasty, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to date; my teacher said the dating is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the dynasty was the whole of the story, meaning the house and not the age. The ⑥ dynasty, meaning the house and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody credits and nobody examines; dynasty, he said, is either something you write of or the only word that means both an age and a house. He said the house is the part they remember.

By 1945 the ⑦ dynasty had become a line in a chronology, and the chronology had become an argument about the short table. The ⑧ dynasty of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in January, was one school and fourteen winters of dating; dynasty, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to date. She said the dating was never mentioned.

The ⑨ dynasty I remember is the one named in the chronology, which fell in 1957 and is still described as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ dynasty, my mother said in 1959, is the only one that improves by being dated; every dynasty, she said, is a house that has agreed to look like an age. She said the house was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 朝代；王朝（指那所学校里讲过的那一朝）
B. n. 朝代；王朝（指那个朝代本身，与统治家族相对）
C. 固定搭配：write of a dynasty 记述一个朝代
D. n. 朝代；王朝（指留给后世的那一个）
E. n. 朝代；王朝（抽象总称，指一所学校的断代之事）
F. n. 朝代；王朝（指年表上写到、被列名的那一朝）
G. n. 王朝；家族统治（指故事里人人都归功却无人查考的那样东西）
H. n. 家族统治（抽象总称，指人人都归功却无人查考的那种统治）

items.q: wrote of a dynasty that no student in the school would have dated
The dynasty, meaning the age and not the house
the dynasty was the whole of the story
the dynasty had become a line in a chronology
The dynasty of the whole thing
A dynasty, my mother said in 1959

answers.why: write of a dynasty 意为“记述一个朝代”，1936 年老师记述了一个学校里没有一个学生肯断定年代的朝代。
dynasty 意为“朝代、王朝”，指那个朝代本身而不是统治家族，它经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
dynasty 意为“朝代、王朝”，指那所学校里的每一个朝代，每一个后头都有同一张短短的年表。
dynasty 意为“朝代、王朝”，指留给后世的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
dynasty 意为“王朝、家族统治”，指故事里人人都归功却无人查考的那样东西，叔叔说这个家族统治就是那个故事的全部。
dynasty 意为“家族统治”，指人人都归功却无人查考的那种统治而不是那个朝代，是故事里人人都归功、却无人查考的东西。
dynasty 意为“朝代、王朝”，指年表上写到、被列名的那一朝，到 1945 年这一朝成了年表里的一行。
dynasty 意为“朝代、王朝”，老师一月写道，整件事的断代之事是一所学校和十四个冬天的考订年代。
dynasty 意为“朝代、王朝”，我记得的是年表上列名的那一朝，1957 年亡了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一朝。
dynasty 为抽象总称，母亲 1959 年说，一个朝代是唯一会因为被好好考订年代而变得更好的东西。
